_comment: Every address this site has, with the title and description that address alone gets.
One file rather than four, because four readers need the same list and none of them can
import the others: the React app (SeoHead writes these tags into the document head), the
Express server (an address that is not here is not a page, so it answers 404 instead of a
copy of the home page), scripts/generate-seo.js (robots.txt and sitemap.xml) and
scripts/prerender.js (one snapshot per route, so a crawler that runs no JavaScript is
handed the page rather than an empty <div id="root">).
noindex: an address that exists and works, but has no business in a search result.
redirects: addresses the router answers with <Navigate>, which a crawler reads as a second
copy of the target page — the server answers them with a 301 before the app loads.
